body: Words cannot express what I witnessed today. I had serious doubts that we would meet today’s guidelines due to all the obstacles that were placed in our way. Not only did you succeed, you did so almost effortlessly and seamlessly. Your staff is tremendous and a gift to work with. As I look back I’m still amazed at what we accomplished! All this is above and beyond the services you extended to the Jersey City Department of Public Safety!
author: Robert A. Baker, Sr., MBA, CFE, DRCC
position: Director, Public Safety Communications & Information Technology
